newsitem.title: USA: Jesse Jackson arrested during protest.
newsitem.headline: Jesse Jackson arrested during protest.

text.p: Political activist and civil rights leader, the Rev. Jesse Jackson, was arrested on Monday during a protest and prayer vigil outside a construction site in Chicago, police said.
Jackson and others were at a garage being built at the Museum of Science and Industry to protest hiring and firing policies when he allegedly ran afoul of a police order.
The civil rights leader, who twice sought the Democratic party's presidential nomination, was charged with disorderly conduct and taken to a police station.
His spokeswoman said he had requested a hearing and would probably remain in jail overnight to underscore his feelings about the situation.
